use_cases: Display user profile pictures in navigation headers or sidebars
Show user avatars in comment sections, reviews, or forum threads
Represent users in data tables, user lists, or team directories
Provide fallback initials display when profile images fail to load
Use in messaging interfaces to identify senders and receivers
ai_summary: A reusable avatar component built on Radix UI primitives that displays user profile images with automatic fallback to initials when images fail to load. Includes AvatarImage and AvatarFallback sub-components for complete state handling.
